title: Where I Come From…
description: When you tell someone a new story from your homeland (or about its practices, stories, traditions, etc.), mark and answer a question below and clear a Condition. When all five are marked, gain 1 XP and clear all questions.

submoves.title: Questions
submoves.description:
- What drawback or failure of your homeland still bothers you? __out1_0__

- What heroes or monsters feature in your homeland's stories? __out1_1__

- What unique wonder or danger is native to your homeland? __out1_2__

- What food, art, or event is central to your homeland's lifestyle? __out1_3__

- Who from your homeland do you look up to—or despise? __out1_4__

title: Pack Reader
description: When you Sense the Motive of a group of people, you may ask an extra question below, no matter the roll.

bullets: What recent event still troubles or excites them?
Who have they outcast recently, and where can I find them?
Who is hiding a secret from the others?

title: Sacrificial Rite
description: When you ritually sacrifice something significant to your homeland's wardens (be it ancestors, deities, spirits, totem, etc.), roll+WIS.

bullets: Ask the GM a question about an enemy; they'll answer honestly
Everyone who participated in the ritual clears a Condition
Gain a blessing proportional to the offering you made. Ask for what you want, the GM will say what you get.

outcomes.text: Choose one, but the wardens will not accept your sacrifices again until you've fulfilled a demand; mark XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Tread the Jeweled
description: When you Sense the Motive of someone more powerful than you (politically, physically, economically, etc.), you may always also ask them "How can I best ruin or humiliate you?". When you accomplish it, mark 1 XP and clear a Condition.

title: Unerring Intuition
description: When you arrive at a place you haven't visited before, roll+WIS.

outcomes.text: The GM will tell you what's terribly wrong here; ask a follow-up question and gain **adv** to the first Move you roll when acting on the answer.
As a 10+ but the answer disturbs or unsettles you; mark a Condition.
You get a cryptic hint…and nothing more; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
